product_line: The center of the GXE world.

experience.principle: GXE illuminates the world. The world exists to showcase the piece.
experience.stage_1: A black void presents a single press-and-hold invitation.
experience.stage_2: Individual stones reveal chrome GXE first, then the purple structural star completes the ice-out.
experience.stage_3: Accumulated jewelry light blooms into the featured product scene.
